## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] New/changed behavior has unit tests in `tests/unit/`
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated if cross-component behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets or environment-specific values hardcoded
- [ ] `.env.example` updated if new environment variables were introduced
- [ ] ADR added in `docs/adr/` if this introduces an architectural change
- [ ] Documentation (README, comments) updated as needed
